concern_summary: Catalog Update: Replace Old Product Listings and Add New Product
resolution_sop: 1. Verify the seller by confirming the registered mobile number and name. 2. Instruct the seller to download and open the IndiaMART mobile app. 3. Have the seller log in using the registered mobile number. 4. Ask the seller to confirm they see "Hi <Name>" at the top. 5. Tap the three horizontal lines (menu) at the top. 6. Go to Seller Tools. 7. Open Manage Product. 8. Locate the old product (e.g., the listing showing "Jeans" or "Man Jeans"). 9. Tap the product name to edit it if you want to rename it. 10. If editing is not desired, tap the three dots next to the product and choose Deactivate. 11. Confirm deactivation to remove the old product from active listings. 12. Go to Add Product to create a new listing. 13. Enter the new product name (e.g., charcoal). 14. Fill price, quantity, description, and specifications. 15. Add GST details if available. 16. Save the new product and verify it appears in Manage Product. 17. Offer to perform deactivation or product addition on behalf of the seller if they want help. 18. Recommend subscription options and explain GST benefits for business growth. 19. Offer transfer to the premium department for promotional subscriptions if the seller is interested.
sentiment_transition: Neutral/briefly confused to cooperative and satisfied after resolution

concern_summary: Service Listing Activation and GST Eligibility
resolution_sop:
1. Verify caller identity. Ask for caller name and registered company name. Confirm the registered mobile number.
2. Confirm GST ownership. Ask if GST is in the business name or another person's name.
3. Advise eligibility based on GST. If GST is not in your business name, recommend free listing only. If GST is in the same business name, explain paid service eligibility.
4. Ask for missing business details. Collect full address and a nearby landmark.
5. Login and navigation. Open the IndiaMART app. Tap the three horizontal lines on the top-left.
6. Go to Seller Store. Click Seller Store > Manage Product.
7. Update address and service locations. Edit business address and add landmark so buyers can find you.
8. Add or edit services. For each service add a clear photo, title, price, short description, and service location. Remove unrelated products (for example, air cooler) if present.
9. Verify category and nature of business. Ensure service category matches the GST nature of business if you plan to upgrade.
10. Set up PNS numbers. Link up to five alternate contact numbers to the PNS so incoming calls ring on all linked numbers.
11. Confirm listing goes live. Save changes and verify the listing appears correctly in search results.
12. Upsell/Value Add: If GST is in the same business name, offer annual paid services for BuyLeads, priority placement, and an assigned account manager to handle queries and improve lead conversion.
sentiment_transition: From confused/concerned about activation to cooperative and satisfied after guided profile updates.

concern_summary: Dashboard Metrics: Understanding Buyer Enquiry Columns
resolution_sop: 1. Greet the caller and ask for permission to verify the account. 2. Ask for the registered mobile number. 3. Ask for company name and location and confirm them aloud. 4. Confirm account type: free seller or paid seller. 5. If audio is poor, ask the caller to repeat or offer to call back. 6. Instruct the caller to log in. 7. Navigate: Go to Dashboard > Enquiries or Leads. 8. Click any requirement or buyer enquiry to open the detailed view. 9. Point to the columns labeled 'Calls Attempted' and 'Responses' on that enquiry. 10. Explain: 'Calls Attempted' shows the recorded call attempts associated with that enquiry. 11. Explain: 'Responses' shows the number of buyer replies or interactions on that enquiry. 12. Clarify privacy: explain that full buyer contact details are accessible only via paid/premium packages or when the buyer shares contact info. 13. If the caller requests to view a buyer page, offer a guided walkthrough of a public sample requirement. Do not share private buyer contact details. 14. If the caller is evaluating premium options, offer to arrange a sales callback and capture the preferred time. 15. Upsell/Value Add: Summarize benefits of premium leads—direct buyer details, buyleads, and priority visibility—and offer to connect to sales now.
sentiment_transition: Customer started confused and seeking clarification. Conversation became frustrated due to audio and miscommunication. Call ended unresolved with ask to escalate to sales.

concern_summary: Service Listing and Lead Acquisition for Manpower Provider
resolution_sop:
1. Ask the caller to confirm the registered seller name and business. Ask them to open the IndiaMART app and confirm they are logged in.
2. Instruct the seller to tap the three horizontal lines on the top-left of the app.
3. Tell the seller to tap Seller Tools from the menu.
4. Tell the seller to tap Manage Product to view existing listings.
5. Guide the seller to add or edit products by tapping Add Product or Multiple Add.
6. Instruct the seller to upload 3 to 4 clear photos per product, add a concise description, and set prices. Save each product.
7. Advise the seller to raise the listing score above 80 by completing photos, description, and pricing to improve visibility.
8. If irrelevant inquiries came from a wrong requirement, tell the seller to delete that requirement to stop calls.
9. If they need immediate buyer contacts, show them the Buy Lead option and explain single-lead consumption to connect with buyers.
10. Offer support hours and next steps: tell them to contact support between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM for help or to send photos via WhatsApp for listing assistance.
11. Upsell: Recommend buying Buy Lead credits for instant leads and suggest improving multiple listings to boost organic inquiries.
sentiment_transition: Customer started confused and concerned about unwanted calls. After guidance on app navigation and listing steps they became clarified and reassured.

concern_summary: Catalog Update: Upload Product Images and Details via Seller Portal
resolution_sop: 1. Greet the seller and confirm identity. Ask for the registered mobile number and registered business name. 2. Verify which mobile number is registered on the portal. Clarify if multiple numbers belong to the same seller. 3. Instruct the seller to open seller.indiamart.com. Click Login. Enter the registered mobile number. Complete OTP verification. 4. From the dashboard go to Products > My Products. Locate the specific product entry to update. 5. Click the product to open its edit page. On the right/side panel find Photos & Videos or Media. 6. Click Upload. Add clear images and optional video. Include front view, close-up of bristles/texture, packaging, and a usage/context image. 7. Fill product attributes: product type, bristle type, disposable or reusable, brand, MRP/price, short description, and benefits. 8. Save the changes. Preview the product page to confirm photos and details display correctly. 9. If a sales rep provided an official WhatsApp number, you may send photos there. Note: photos sent to WhatsApp may be attached but you must still update details on the portal. 10. If the product does not appear, clear browser cache or log out and log in again. If issues persist, request a support callback or raise a help ticket. 11. Offer Premium Services as value add: explain lead delivery, priority listing, and TrustSeal verification. Ask if the seller wants a callback for plan details.
sentiment_transition: Neutral/uncertain due to registration confusion → Cooperative and receptive to instructions; politely declined premium offer.

concern_summary: Lead Purchase vs Seller Listing Mismatch
resolution_sop: 1. Verify customer identity. Ask for registered name, company name, and mobile number. Confirm the transaction amount and time. 2. Ask the customer to log in or guide them to log in. Say: Go to Seller Dashboard > Payments > Transactions. 3. In Transactions, locate the ₹470 entry. Click View Details. 4. Check transaction type. If it shows 'Single Lead' or 'Buyer Details', tell the customer this payment bought one buyer lead. 5. Navigate to My Requirements or Enquiries. Click the listed requirement. If the customer did not intend to post a requirement, click Delete or Disable. 6. Navigate to My Catalog > My Listings. Confirm seller listings are active and correct. Turn off any unwanted 'buy' posts. 7. If the customer requests a refund and it meets policy, Click Raise Refund or Contact Billing Team. Note the refund reference ID and share ETA. 8. If the transaction is non-refundable or within policy limits, explain options clearly: use the single lead contact, or request support to escalate. 9. Offer immediate assistance: if the customer wants, arrange a callback from the packages team. Transfer the call or create a callback ticket. 10. Close with value add. Explain package benefits for sellers. Offer a short trial or a package demo to get daily leads.
sentiment_transition: Customer confused and frustrated about payment purpose to calmer and agreeable after explanation and callback arrangement.

concerns.concern_summary: Catalog integrity issue due to unauthorized edits and product deactivation
concerns.resolution_sop: 1. Verify the seller’s identity and confirm they are logged in. 2. Ask if they are on the mobile app. 3. In the app, tap Add Product. 4. Tap the three dots on the top right. 5. Tap Deactivate products to view inactive items. 6. Open each inactive product and tap Activate. 7. Open a few active products and compare photos, titles, and details with the seller’s original uploads or screenshots. 8. If titles or material show brass instead of metal, note the exact items and changes needed. 9. Inform support on the call to correct names and material from brass to metal. 10. Request restoration of removed photos and descriptions for each affected model. 11. Ask the agent to raise a concern and record that no catalog changes should occur without the seller’s permission. 12. Request confirmation once updates and restorations are completed. 13. For added value, once the catalog is back to normal, suggest considering a longer-duration plan for stable visibility and continuity.

sops.concern_summary: Unauthorized Catalog Changes: Escalation and Prevention
sops.resolution_sop: 1. Verify the seller’s identity and confirm account details. 2. Confirm which products were modified and note the modified date shown in the panel. 3. Raise a concern to the catalog/design team about unauthorized changes. 4. Request rollback or correction for titles, material, photos, and activation status. 5. Add an account note: no catalog changes without seller approval. 6. Share the ticket ID and expected resolution timeline with the seller. 7. After resolution, offer a brief catalog health review and suggest an annual plan for stable support and better lead visibility.
